# akp_service_account (Resource)

Manages an Akuity Platform service account: a non-human identity that workloads assume by exchanging a token from a trusted `akp_oidc_issuer`. The account may be scoped to the whole organization (omit `workspace`) or to a single workspace (set `workspace`), with the same role and custom role rules as `akp_api_key`. Everything but `workspace` is updated in place; changing `oidc_binding` revokes the credentials already issued to the account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `oidc_binding` (Attributes) Which tokens may be exchanged for this account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc_binding))
- `permissions` (Attributes) Permissions granted to the account. At least one of `roles` or `custom_roles` is required. Org-scoped accounts take `member`; workspace-scoped accounts take `admin` or `member`. The organization owner role is never allowed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--permissions))

### Optional

- `description` (String) Human-readable description
- `disabled` (Boolean) A disabled account cannot exchange tokens and its outstanding credentials stop working immediately.
- `ip_allowlist` (List of String) CIDR ranges the account's credentials may be exchanged and used from. Omit to leave it unrestricted. Not available on self-hosted installations.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace name. When set, the account is scoped to this workspace and holds workspace roles; when omitted, it is org-scoped.

### Read-Only

- `create_time` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of account creation
- `id` (String) Service account ID. Workloads pass it as `service_account_id` on the token exchange.
- `last_used_time` (String) RFC3339 timestamp of the last request made with one of the account's credentials. Empty until first use.
- `workspace_id` (String) ID of the workspace the account is scoped to. Empty for org-scoped accounts.

<a id="nestedatt--oidc_binding"></a>
### Nested Schema for `oidc_binding`

Required:

- `issuer_id` (String) ID of the `akp_oidc_issuer` whose tokens are accepted
- `match` (Map of String) Claim name to regular expression; every entry must match the whole claim value. `sub` is required and must not match arbitrary subjects. Nested claims use dotted paths, e.g. `kubernetes.io.namespace`.


<a id="nestedatt--permissions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `permissions`

Optional:

- `actions` (List of String) Action grants (uncommon; usually empty)
- `custom_roles` (List of String) IDs of custom roles to bind to the key
- `roles` (List of String) Built-in role names. Org-scoped accounts take `member`; workspace-scoped accounts take `admin` or `member`. `owner` is never allowed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# Org-scoped account: import by ID.
terraform import akp_service_account.ci 0oloibn1zx313c3f

# Workspace-scoped account: import as <workspace name>/<id>.
terraform import akp_service_account.platform_deployer platform/orhd9y2tk1zxxtnv
```
